backend/main.mo: Motoko backend managing products, orders, user profiles, and a full service-quote system with admin‑restricted retrieval and updates.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report tracing the removal of a storefront text string to the impacted frontend file and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all major frontend files describing their roles in routing, UI, admin tools, hooks, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base layer defining global OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML shell providing the mount point and loading the main frontend script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router, React Query, theme provider, and all storefront and admin routes.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with Manitoba service branding, contact info, navigation links, social icons, and Caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with logo, service‑area subtitle, navigation links, and a cart button with item count badge.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Page layout wrapper adding header, footer, and routed main content.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Reusable product card showing image, name, description, price, and link to product details with fallback imagery.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/FaqSe: Renders an FAQ section using an accordion with predefined questions and answers.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Testi: Displays customer testimonials in cards with star ratings and text.
frontend/src/components/Storefront/Trust: Shows a grid of trust indicators with icons and short labels.
frontend/src/constants/serviceAreaCopy.t: Exports a simple string describing the service area.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user's identity and refreshes dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminLeads.ts: Provides hooks for fetching and updating service quotes via the actor with toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminOrders.ts: Provides hooks to fetch all orders and update order statuses through the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminProducts.ts: Provides hooks to manage products including listing, creating, updating, archiving, and restoring.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminUsers.ts: Defines a hook to grant admin permissions by email with success and error toasts.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Fetches the caller's user role from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements Internet Identity auth context, handling identity load, login, logout, and state.
frontend/src/hooks/usePlaceOrder.ts: Provides a mutation to place an order and invalidate related queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useProducts.ts: Hooks for fetching active products and individual product details.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceQuotes.ts: Defines a mutation for requesting service quotes with query invalidation and toasts.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup with CSS variables for theming and base styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLayout.tsx: Admin layout that handles authentication, role checks, and navigation for admin pages.
Displays and manages service quote leads with status updates, sorting, and admin notes.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrdersPage: Shows all orders with editable status selections and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProductsPa: Provides product creation, editing, and archiving with modal forms and product lists.
Interface for granting admin permissions to users by email with guidance and validation.
frontend/src/pages/CartPage.tsx: Renders the shopping cart with item quantity controls, removal actions, and an empty-cart state redirect to browse products.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Implements checkout form validation and order submission, then redirects to confirmation and clears the cart.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Displays a confirmation message and order ID after successful checkout with a button to continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetailPage.tsx: Loads and displays product details with quantity selection and add‑to‑cart functionality, handling loading and error states.
frontend/src/pages/RequestQuotePage.tsx: Provides a form for service quote requests with validation, submission handling, and a success confirmation screen.
frontend/src/pages/StorefrontPage.tsx: Shows a hero section, marketing content, and active products with navigation to quotes or product listings.
frontend/src/store/cart.ts: Zustand store managing cart items with add, remove, update, clear, and total calculation.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers to read URL parameters, persist them in sessionStorage, and optionally remove them from the URL hash. Provides functions for getting, storing, retrieving, and clearing parameters with URL-first precedence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom colors, typography, container queries, animations, and responsive container settings. Extends theme tokens like colors, radii, fonts, shadows, and accordion animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current app goals, requirements, architectural notes, issues, and implemented features. Tracks versioning and evolving user requests such as design, content changes, and admin configuration.
